args: TOKEN="$(printf %s "${PROWL_MCP_TOKEN:-}" | tr -d "[:space:]")"; if [ -z "$TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.prowl/prowl_mcp_token" ]; then TOKEN="$(tr -d "[:space:]" < "$HOME/.prowl/prowl_mcp_token")"; fi; if [ -z "$TOKEN" ] && [ -f "$HOME/.codex/prowl_mcp_token" ]; then TOKEN="$(tr -d "[:space:]" < "$HOME/.codex/prowl_mcp_token")"; fi; if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then echo 'prowl: no API key; the MCP server will not start.' >&2; echo 'prowl: store one with:  npx @prowl-ai/prowl-skill token' >&2; echo 'prowl: or set PROWL_MCP_TOKEN in the environment.' >&2; echo 'prowl: not falling back to OAuth - browser consent cannot finish inside MCP startup.' >&2; exit 78; fi; exec npx -y mcp-remote https://prowl.chat/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --transport http-first --silent
